fixed.explanation: validate_metadata calls array_equivalent with dtype_equal=True even when the new and stored categories have different dtypes (int vs float). That skips the dtype check and reaches low-level code, which raises a buffer dtype mismatch. The fix treats differing dtypes as different categories and passes dtype_equal=True only when the dtypes match.
